status: Proposed during the 2026-11-14 scoring audit by Claude Code. Not yet reviewed by a team member.
basis: Each annotation restates the case's own criteria and notes in evaluation/test_cases.json, which were written on 2026-11-13, before any live run. Values and date markers are copied from those criteria. The annotations were written after the live results had been read, so a team member should confirm them independently.

relationships.unresolved_contradiction: The sources make incompatible statements about the same thing and nothing in them says which is right. Expected: status conflicting_evidence, with every value reported and none chosen.
relationships.superseded: A later document explicitly replaces an earlier value, for example an amendment. Expected: the current value. The earlier value may be mentioned only in a sentence that says it was replaced. Flagging a conflict is allowed but not required.
relationships.different_context: The values differ because they describe different dates, scopes or assumptions, and each is correct in its own context. Expected: every value with its context marker, such as its 'as of' date. Flagging a conflict is allowed but not required.
relationships.compatible: The sources agree or add complementary facts. Expected: the combined facts, with no conflict flagged.

CF-01.basis: notes: 'Genuine contradiction: neither document explains the difference.' criteria: 'Reports both dates ... without choosing one.'

CF-02.basis: criteria: 'Gives both figures with their as-of dates ($112,400 as of September 30, 2026; $118,900 as of October 10, 2026) and explains they differ by reporting date.' notes: 'Context difference, not a contradiction.'

CF-03.basis: criteria: '99.9% under Amendment No. 1 (raised from 99.5%); the amendment prevails.'

MD-01.basis: criteria: '$5,200.00 from July 1, 2026 (amendment, page 1), replacing $4,500.00; the amendment prevails.'

MD-02.basis: criteria: '90 days under the amendment (previously 60 days, MSA page 1).'

MD-03.basis: criteria: 'Both documents agree.' notes: 'Agreement across documents; should not be reported as a conflict.'

MD-04.basis: criteria: complementary facts from the services agreement and the status report.
